label: A Hat in Time sandboxes
description: How A Hat in Time sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Mods live in HatInTimeGame/Mods, one folder each. The shipped ModManager.exe in Binaries is the game's own tool for creating them.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
